description: SDR, ADS-B, AIS, spectrum scanner and ISM radio tools for CardputerZero

store.summary: Pocket radio lab: SDR, scanner, ADS-B, AIS and ISM with an RTL-SDR dongle
store.description:
ZeroRadio turns the CardputerZero into a pocket receiver. Plug an RTL-SDR dongle (for example the RTL-SDR Blog V4) into the USB-A port and open the hub.

- SDR: spectrum, waterfall and WFM/FM/AM/USB/LSB/CW audio on the speaker.
- Scanner: sweep a wide band, list the strongest signals, open one in the SDR.
- ISM: 433/868 MHz weather sensors, tyre pressure sensors and remotes.
- ADS-B: aircraft list, radar and world map at 1090 MHz.
- AIS: ship list, radar and world map at 162 MHz.

Every decoder runs on the device, with no computer or network. Set your position by city, coordinates or GPS (Cap LoRa-1262-GPS or a USB GPS). Press H in any app for its help. The package bundles readsb and AIS-catcher (GPL-3.0); see Credits in the app.
